message: Defined the prediction target: for each membership year in <the catalog entity you picked>, predict whether the member renews. It's a yes/no (classification) problem judged by AUC, decided 31 days before the year ends, and years whose renewal window has not closed yet are left out (censoring).
reasoning: The user's goal and population were clear; I picked the training-unit entity and every column from the entity catalog and proposed a point-in-time unit with its censoring rule.

updateElements.Goal: Identify members at risk of not renewing so the retention team can intervene before the year ends.

Unit.GroupKey: <the column a member's rows share, if any>
